company.name: CircuCity
company.mission: Structured circular commerce: build the infrastructure that connects second-hand stores, sustainable brands and consumers so circular trade becomes the default, not the exception.
company.vision: A global circular economy where pre-loved goods flow freely and everyone is rewarded for participating.
company.business_model: B2B2C marketplace for second-hand and vintage goods, monetised through seller fees and subscriptions; AI-powered commerce products (Cira, Gavriel) sold as SaaS; partner-led customer acquisition.
company.philosophy: Circular commerce as infrastructure. Second-hand stores list unique stock covering-by-one-sustainability improvements, CO₂ savings and EcoTokens rewards.
company.stage: Early-stage startup, actively recruiting global sales partners and strategic partnerships.
strategic_objectives: Grow marketplace inventory and buyer base in target countries
Convert ecommerce brands to the Cira AI sales/support product
Automate listing workflows for inventory-heavy resellers via Gavriel
Build a global network of growth and sales partners
Sign strategic partnerships with circular-economy organisations and investors
